verdict.rationale: Tavily's Crawl feature explicitly traverses a website's content starting from a base URL with instructions (e.g., 'Find all pages on the Python SDK'), and Map lets engineers discover site structure from a base URL — directly matching the story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party validation of crawl depth/scale and clearer documentation on starting a crawl directly from a search result rather than a known URL.
